title: AppleTM
description: Briefly introduce that this data pack adds more crafting recipes and achievements to your world
body:
此数据包会修改原版的一些东西
请谨慎加载到已经生成的世界中

数据包内容:
为一些原版没法合成的物品添加了合成表
添加了一堆没用的进度...
修改了一些原版的附魔
_一个维度(Test)_
好吧，就这些.....

(以下为100%机翻)
Data Pack Content:
Added crafting recipes for some items that couldn't be crafted in the original version
Added a bunch of useless advancements...
Modified some of the original enchantments
_A Dimension_
Alright, that's it.....

### Install
拖入 ./saves/(WorldName)/datapacks 文件夹即可
Just drag it into the ./saves/(WorldName)/datapacks folder
